issues.description: download_and_untar.sh violates its name's contract — never downloads, and silently continues when unzip is missing.
issues.detail: LEAKY-ABSTRACTION. The script is named download_and_untar.sh, matching the supertype contract used across ESPnet recipes (download if absent, extract). This implementation only extracts and prints a message when archives are missing, returning success. The `command -v unzip` check also lacks `exit`, so the script proceeds without unzip. Either rename to `extract.sh` or honor the contract (fail loudly when archives absent).

issues.description: local/data.sh argument-parsing contract is broken: --downloads_dir is parsed but never forwarded.
issues.detail: SPEC-MISSING / LSP-VIOLATION against the recipe-data.sh contract. The script declares `downloads_dir=` and `parse_options.sh`, but then calls `download_and_untar.sh "${TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH}" "${downloads_dir}"` with an unset/empty second argument under `set -u` semantics for the callee. The advertised --downloads_dir option silently does nothing useful and may error. State and honor the precondition.

issues.description: run.sh sets use_lm=false but README reports LM decoding results — contract mismatch between recipe and documented outputs.
issues.detail: SPEC-MISSING. The recipe's run.sh disables the LM (`use_lm=false`), yet README.md advertises `decode_asr_branchformer_lm_...` results as reproducible. A user running run.sh as-is cannot reproduce the LM rows. Either default `use_lm=true` or document the override required. The recipe's promise to its caller must match what it delivers.

issues.description: README ASR config path is wrong (./conf/train/train_asr_...yaml) — broken link in the contract documentation.
issues.detail: LEAKY-ABSTRACTION in the docs. The link target `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` has an extra `train/` segment; the file lives at `./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml`. Small but the README is the recipe's externally visible spec; broken paths erode trust in the contract.

issues.description: Speaker-ID convention assumes directory layout one level above the wav file — fragile, undocumented invariant.
issues.detail: SPEC-MISSING. `prepare_kaldi` derives speaker IDs as `TALASR$(NF-1)`, hard-coding that the parent directory name is the speaker. This invariant is neither stated nor validated; any nesting variation in the archives silently produces wrong utt2spk. State the precondition on wav_dir structure and assert it, or compute speakers from the transcript metadata which is the authoritative source.

issues.description: local/path.sh is a duplicate, partial copy of TEMPLATE/asr1/path.sh and is unused by run.sh.
issues.detail: WRONG-BOUNDARY. The top-level path.sh is symlinked to the template (correct), but `local/path.sh` is a one-line file containing only `MAIN_ROOT=...` and is sourced nowhere in this recipe (data.sh sources `./path.sh`). It duplicates a fragment of the template contract without honoring it. Remove it or symlink to the template.

review.summary: The recipe largely conforms to the ESPnet recipe ADT — symlinks to TEMPLATE/asr1, standard conf/ layout, kaldi-style data prep. But several contracts are quietly violated: `download_and_untar.sh` doesn't download and doesn't fail when archives are missing; `local/data.sh` accepts `--downloads_dir` but never forwards it; run.sh disables the LM that README claims as a result; and the speaker-ID derivation encodes an unstated invariant about directory layout. These are spec/contract gaps rather than algorithmic bugs — the kind of leaks that break substitutability across the egs2/ recipe family over time. Fix the contracts and the recipe is sound.
